gameDescriptionHtml:
EMBARK ON A MUSICAL ADVENTURE

Will you unite the splintered pantheon of Norwyn to defeat Mar, the Queen of Terror? Fight, jump, and dodge obstacles and menacing enemies as you ski further into the darkness that has befallen the snow covered land of Norwyn.

GEAR UP, CONQUER THE TRAILS – A fresh blend of precision combat and challenging roguelike gameplay, all set to a mesmerizing soundtrack. Prepare for battle by upgrading skills and weapons and choose the right path to victory by weaving trails through mountainous landscapes.
FEEL THE DYNAMIC SOUNDTRACK – Get in the flow with Fresh Tracks’ rich, genre-crossing soundtrack that surprises with each new track and dynamically responds to your every movement. With 28 original songs, the soundtrack is the perfect match for the high intensity trails, with lyrics that immerse you into the world and legends of Norwyn.

Game Features

  • Rhythm-Driven Gameplay: Movement, combat, and progression seamlessly sync with a dynamic, evolving soundtrack.
  • Story-Rich with Full Voice Acting: Meet the Mythics, the Gods of Norwyn, through story and song – all fully voiced by legends like Peter Stormare (Fargo, Until Dawn) and Michael Antonakos (Assassin’s Creed Odyssey, Gotham Knights).
  • High Replayability: Roguelite mechanics encourage skiers to refine their skills while unlocking upgrades and strategies for future runs.
  • A Deeply Immersive Soundtrack: Get in the flow with Fresh Tracks’ rich, genre-crossing 28-track soundtrack that surprises with each new beat track and dynamically responds to your every movement.
